facts.fact: Adwave says TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram all run from a $30/day minimum, using ads created from the advertiser's website.
facts.quote: With Adwave, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram all run from a $30/day minimum, using ads created from your website.

facts.fact: Adwave says Reddit ads are optional and run from about $35/day.
facts.quote: Optional; runs from about $35/day in Adwave

facts.fact: Adwave campaigns run on a prepaid daily budget from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription or contract, according to the Adwave pricing page.
facts.quote: Adwave campaigns run on a prepaid daily budget from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription or contract

facts.fact: Adwave's budget table lists a $30/day budget as covering TV, Google Search, Google (YouTube and Demand Gen), Facebook and Instagram, and mobile web and apps, with a 30-active-day total of $900.
facts.quote: | $30/day | TV, Google Search, Google (YouTube and Demand Gen), Facebook and Instagram, mobile web and apps | $900 |

facts.fact: Adwave's budget table lists an about $35/day budget as adding Reddit, with a 30-active-day total of about $1,050.
Adwave's pricing page example uses a $75/day budget, listed as $2,250 over 30 active days.
facts.quote: [$75/day](https://adwave.com/pricing/) (pricing page example) | Same mix with more delivery | $2,250 |

facts.fact: Adwave's budget table lists an about $91/day budget as making TikTok available as an opt-in channel, with a 30-active-day total of about $2,730.
facts.quote: | About $91/day | TikTok becomes available as an opt-in channel you turn on and connect | About $2,730 |

facts.fact: Adwave says extra creative costs $0.38 per image.
facts.quote: Extra creation costs [$0.38](https://adwave.com/pricing/) per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave says extra creative costs $6 per social video.
facts.quote: per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave says extra creative costs $6 per 15-second TV spot.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave says agencies running client campaigns pay for a separate license that starts at $499/month, with media at cost.
facts.quote: Agencies running client campaigns pay for a separate license that starts at $499/month, with media at cost.

facts.fact: Adwave says a campaign pauses if the prepaid wallet cannot cover that day's budget.
facts.quote: New accounts start with an empty wallet, so you deposit funds when you are ready to launch, and a campaign pauses if the wallet can’t cover the day.

facts.fact: Adwave says card deposits add a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits do not.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits don’t.

facts.fact: Per Mordor Intelligence's aftermarket glass report, replacement made up 78.28% of automotive aftermarket glass spend in 2024.
facts.quote: Replacement made up 78.28% of automotive aftermarket glass spend in 2024, according to Mordor Intelligence’s aftermarket glass report

facts.fact: According to Auto Dealer Today, the FTC sent warning letters to 97 auto dealer groups on March 13 over deceptive pricing practices.
facts.quote: The FTC sent warning letters to 97 auto dealer groups on March 13 over deceptive pricing practices, [Auto Dealer Today reported]

facts.fact: The FTC has stated that advertised prices must include all nonoptional costs.
facts.quote: the agency has made clear that advertised prices must include all nonoptional costs.

facts.fact: The FTC's Endorsement Guides, which govern reviews and testimonials in ads, were revised in 2023.
facts.quote: the FTC’s Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials and its Endorsement Guides, revised in 2023

facts.fact: In Adwave, if one optional channel cannot launch because of budget, audience, creative, settings, or content eligibility, the rest of the campaign still goes live and the advertiser is told why.
facts.quote: if one optional channel can’t launch, the rest of the campaign goes live and you’re told why.

facts.fact: Adwave can report revenue and return on spend when each tracked conversion is given a value, such as an average repair or replacement ticket.
facts.quote: Give each conversion a value, such as your average repair or replacement ticket, and Adwave can report revenue and return on spend.
